prompts.description: Fix Korean swaps returning zero candidates: validateSwapCandidate check #3 compares Korean candidate ingredient names against an English-only allowlist
prompts.prompt: Edit ONLY lib/meal-validator.ts, inside the function validateSwapCandidate, check #3 (the block commented 'No excluded ingredients — selectedIngredients is the user's allowlist'). Problem: swap candidate ingredient names are now Korean (e.g. '닭가슴살'), but userProfile.selectedIngredients stores English names (e.g. 'Chicken breast'), so the exact-match allowlist rejects every Korean candidate and the swap API returns zero candidates ('no valid swaps'). Make TWO changes to check #3 only: (1) Make the allowlist language-aware — add `import { localizeIngredientName } from '@/lib/ingredient-i18n'` at the top of the file, and when building the allowed set, for each selected ingredient `i` add BOTH `i.toLowerCase()` and `localizeIngredientName(i, 'ko').toLowerCase()` to the set. (2) Relax the over-strict rejection — the current loop rejects when ANY candidate ingredient is outside the allowlist (it breaks on the first unlisted item, e.g. oil/seasoning). Change it so the candidate is rejected ONLY when NONE of its ingredients are in the allowed set (i.e. the candidate entirely ignores the user's selected ingredients). Keep checks #1 (calories ±15%), #2 (protein/carbs/fat ±20%), and #4 (breakfast slot) EXACTLY as-is. Do not change any other function. Verify: npm run build passes; in Korean, requesting a meal swap now returns 1-3 candidates instead of 'no valid swaps', and English swaps still work.
